data.name: Power of the Shaitan
data.description: You gain the power of genies to grant wishes. Once per day, you can cast limited wish as a spell-like ability. Such wishes must begin with the words "I wish," and cannot duplicate a wish you have granted within the past 24 hours. If you use this ability to duplicate a spell with a costly material component, you must provide that component. You become immune to acid damage, and can use plane shift once per day to travel to or from the Plane of Earth.

raw_tokens.value: Shaitan Bloodline ~ Power of the Shaitan
Class Feature.Sorcerer Class Feature.Shaitan Bloodline ~ Power LVL 20.Sorcerer Bloodline Power.SpecialQuality.Special Quality.Supernatural

You gain the power of genies to grant wishes. Once per day, you can cast limited wish as a spell-like ability. Such wishes must begin with the words "I wish," and cannot duplicate a wish you have granted within the past 24 hours. If you use this ability to duplicate a spell with a costly material component, you must provide that component. You become immune to acid damage, and can use plane shift once per day to travel to or from the Plane of Earth.
